purpose: Immutable compute.millicpu_ms.v1 and memory.byte_ms.v1 usage facts plus the zero-dollar model-token, provider-call and tool-invocation observability facts, their identity claims, frontier, outbox, receipts, correction heads, quarantine markers, the run and operation closure vectors and the mux activation crash-recovery cursor. The meter attribute is the discriminator; a storage or transfer meter is refused before any write and again on read.

serverSideEncryption.rationale: Billing evidence and customer content are different blast radii, so the usage authorities never share the content or secret key; one key per authority keeps a category compromise from reaching a sibling.

globalSecondaryIndexes.name: gsi_fact_id
globalSecondaryIndexes.rationale: A settlement receipt carries only region, category and factId, so it needs a way back to the workspace partition. Only the ID# claim carries factId as a key attribute, which is also why the claim is a separate item: a GSI cannot be condition-checked and the admission fence has to be a condition. itemType is projected because an INCLUDE projection carries no discriminator of its own, and a row decoded without one is a row decoded as the wrong shape.

globalSecondaryIndexes.name: gsi_outbox_due
globalSecondaryIndexes.rationale: Sixteen shards over an enqueue-instant then sequence ordering, so the sweep reads the oldest undelivered facts first with a bounded page per shard. The index attributes exist only on a pending OUTBOX# row, so a confirmed SendMessage removes the row and with it the index entry.

stream.rationale: NEW_IMAGE is safe here because a fact row holds integers, identifiers and receipt references only: never customer content, never a prompt, never a secret. An observability fact carries token counts and a model identifier, which are already public in the customer's own usage view. The event-source mapping filters itemType = usage_fact on INSERT.

timeToLive.rationale: Every row in an authority table is money evidence. A fact that silently expired would be an unrecoverable accounting gap, so the only TTL in this stream is on rebuildable usage-query-projection detail rows.
